title: bug: get_commit_scope counts the completing seat as an orphan-mode peer of its own completion landing (complete_task has already cleared the assignee), so peersActive is always true there and the default attribution.undeclared 'solo' strands every MEASURED path at a shared-mode completion, even on a one-seat board
description:
Found by defect hunt #10 (task-49a2c07f, architect-1dd28c7c) on 2026-11-03. The holder re-ran the repro and re-derived every line below at HEAD 677d051a.

PROBLEM
- getCommitScope.ts:236-237 counts any caller that is not the assignee as a peer: `const orphanCaller = caller !== null && caller !== task.assignedWorkerId; const activePeerIds = orphanCaller ? [...livePeerIds, caller] : [...livePeerIds];`.
- complete_task's REVIEW write (completeTask.ts:280) goes through taskStore.ts:544-548 (`shouldClearWorker`), which clears assignedWorkerId.
- The seat's own wrapper lands afterwards, at post-flight. Its commit_scope helper (scripts/moe-agent.sh:4121-4134) calls get_commit_scope with the seat's own workerId.
- So at every completion landing the caller is "not the assignee": activePeerIds is [caller] and peersActive is true, whoever else is live.
- The wrapper turns that into declared-only. moe-agent.sh:4604 sets `peers_active = bool(scope.get('peersActive'))`, and :4780 commits MEASURED paths only when `undeclared == 'solo' and not peers_active`.
- Every undeclared changed path then goes to MOE_ATTRIBUTION_UNRESOLVED and task.unattributedPaths, pages #governors (recordCommit.ts:430-431) and is never staged. Typical cases are a shell edit, codegen output or a lockfile.
- The same seat's checkpoint landing, while it is still assigned, gets peersActive false.
- The tool already knows the caller owns this landing. getCommitScope.ts:243 computes the task's finalizing attempt (finalizingAttemptsByTask), the same signal the wrapper's owner guard uses to identify the landing owner. The orphan rule ignores it.
- Broken contract:
  - docs/CONFIGURATION.md:201: solo commits MEASURED "only when no other worker is live".
  - scripts/CLAUDE.md: "default 'solo' = no other live worker".
- The rule dates from bf3f8fa0 (2026-08-29). Its only pinning test (getCommitScope.test.ts:310) covers an assignee-less BLOCKED recoverer, not the completing seat.

EVIDENCE: repro at HEAD 677d051a, run in a git-archive snapshot outside the checkout
- Files: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-49a2c07f/A/zzHuntA_completionOrphan.test.ts, output in zzHuntA_completionOrphan.out.txt.
- Command: `cd packages/moe-daemon && NO_COLOR=1 npx vitest run src/tools/zzHuntA_completionOrphan.test.ts`
- Setup: a WORKING task assigned to worker-1 with an open attempt, then complete_task's two writes (setAttemptPhase finalizing, then updateTask status REVIEW), then get_commit_scope {workerId:'worker-1', phase:'postflight'}.
- The test first confirms assignedWorkerId is null, finalizingAttempt.workerId is 'worker-1' and livePeerIds is [].
- Failing assertion: `expected { active: [ 'worker-1' ], …(1) } to deeply equal { active: [], peersActive: false }`.
- Controls that pass:
  - the same seat's WORKING checkpoint scope gives peersActive false;
  - a non-holder caller (worker-2) is still an orphan peer.
- Result: Tests 1 failed | 2 passed (3).
- A trial of the fix below passed the repro plus getCommitScope.test.ts, 68/68.

FIX DIRECTION
- In getCommitScope.ts, compute `finalizing` (:243) before the orphan rule, and exempt the caller that holds the task's finalizing attempt: `orphanCaller = caller !== null && caller !== task.assignedWorkerId && finalizing?.workerId !== caller`. Every other non-assignee caller stays an orphan peer.
- Name the exemption in the tool description and in the workerId inputSchema description (:119, :124).
- Out of scope: seats freed by their own transition that have no finalizing attempt, such as submit_plan to AWAITING_APPROVAL or report_blocked's seat-freeing arm.
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md: the get_commit_scope workerId comment ("counted in activePeerIds when it is not the assignee") becomes incomplete. 0adea941 holds that file at filing time, so it is not in this row's files. Add the one-line sync only if lanes.js shows the file free when you plan; otherwise the governor files it.

FILES
- packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/getCommitScope.ts
- packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/getCommitScope.test.ts (add cases)
- Neither file is held at filing time.

VERIFICATION
Run vitest in a snapshot or the task worktree, never in the shared checkout: `npx vitest run src/tools/getCommitScope.test.ts`.
definitionOfDone: getCommitScope.test.ts gains a case: an open attempt, then setAttemptPhase('finalizing'), then updateTask({status:'REVIEW'}), with no other worker live. get_commit_scope {workerId: <the finalizing holder>} returns activePeerIds [] and peersActive false. The case fails against today's getCommitScope.ts.

In the same file, a caller that is neither the assignee nor the finalizing holder is still listed in activePeerIds with peersActive true, and the existing BLOCKED-unassigned orphan case (getCommitScope.test.ts:310) passes unchanged.
`npx vitest run src/tools/getCommitScope.test.ts` passes in full, and the workerId inputSchema description in getCommitScope.ts names the finalizing-holder exemption (grep-checkable).

implementationPlan.description:
The fix, with your Edit tool.
(a) packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/getCommitScope.ts, liveness block (about :231-243). Move `const finalizing = finalizingAttemptsByTask(state).get(task.id);`, with its two-line 'finalizing hold' comment, ABOVE the orphan rule. Then make the rule `const orphanCaller = caller !== null && caller !== task.assignedWorkerId && finalizing?.workerId !== caller;`. Extend the orphan comment: "The holder of the task's finalizing attempt is exempt: it is the seat landing its own completion, and complete_task's REVIEW write cleared its assignment before its wrapper's post-flight asks." Keep the activePeerIds/assignee/assigneeProtected lines as they are.
(b) Tool description (:119): replace `an orphan-mode caller (workerId not the assignee) is counted in activePeerIds` with `an orphan-mode caller (workerId neither the assignee nor the holder of the task\'s finalizing attempt) is counted in activePeerIds`.
(c) workerId inputSchema description (:124): replace `counted in activePeerIds when it is not the assignee.` with `counted in activePeerIds when it is neither the assignee nor the holder of the task\'s finalizing attempt (the seat landing its own completion after complete_task cleared the assignee).`. Afterwards, `grep -c "nor the holder of the task" packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/getCommitScope.ts` must print 2.
(d) docs/MCP_SERVER.md:719, get_commit_scope Parameters: change the workerId comment's `counted in activePeerIds when it is not the assignee` to `counted in activePeerIds when it is neither the assignee nor the holder of the task's finalizing attempt`. That one line only: it is no vendored doc, so no regen is needed. task-0adea941 (REVIEW, already landed) holds this file, but its hunks sit at :2040 and :2991-3016, so merge-tree takes both.
Error handling: the fix adds no failure path.
- `finalizing` is the existing per-task Map lookup, undefined when no attempt holds the task. Optional chaining keeps undefined a non-match, so every caller that does not hold THIS task's finalizing attempt keeps today's orphan behaviour, the :310 BLOCKED recoverer included.
- finalizingAttemptsByTask already skips malformed records (isHoldingFinalizingAttempt), so a corrupt attempt can never exempt anyone.
- The handler's refusals for a missing taskId, a bad phase or since, and an unknown task are unchanged.
Touch no other file. In particular, scripts/tests/postflight-fake-proxy.js:795 copies the old rule, and that is a follow-up, not this row.
implementationPlan.note: Moved the finalizing lookup above the orphan rule and exempted the finalizing holder; the tool description and the workerId description both name the exemption (grep count 2); MCP_SERVER.md:719 synced.

Adversarial self-review of your own diff (`git diff`). Fix any finding, re-run step 3, then call complete_task.
(1) Scope: exactly three files. getCommitScope.ts changes only the moved `finalizing` line and its comment, the orphan rule plus its comment, and the two descriptions. MCP_SERVER.md changes only line 719. The test file changes only the new block.
(2) Who gets exempted?
- Only `finalizing?.workerId === caller`, for THIS task.
- A null caller is never an orphan (the `caller !== null` guard stays first).
- A seat freed with no finalizing attempt is still an orphan, as the row's scope says: submit_plan to AWAITING_APPROVAL, report_blocked's seat-freeing arm.
(3) Could the completing seat be a genuine concurrent actor? No:
- claim_next_task withholds the row from every other seat while the finalizing hold exists;
- a crashed seat's relaunch under the same worker id owns the same landing.
The exemption only restores 'solo' = no OTHER live worker (docs/CONFIGURATION.md attribution.undeclared). (o4) proves a real peer still flips peersActive.
(4) Worktree mode lands with no tiers and never reads peersActive. The wrapper reads only peersActive (moe-agent.sh:4604, ps1 :4244), so no wrapper change is needed.
(5) No ordering hazard: finalizingAttemptsByTask is a pure read of state.attempts, now evaluated a few lines earlier in the same synchronous block.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
Four ways to stop counting the completing seat as a peer were weighed.
(1) Chosen, as the row's fix direction says: exempt the caller that holds THIS task's finalizing attempt. That is the signal the owner guard and claim_next_task's finalizing hold already use for the landing's owner.
(2) Exempting any caller of an unassigned REVIEW row: too broad. A different seat recovering the row would be exempt too.
(3) Using assigneeProtected: wrong signal. It describes the assignee, and the assignee is null at this point.
(4) Keeping the assignee in complete_task until the landing finalizes: a large blast radius across claim, QA gating and release routing, all for one attribution answer.
The docs/MCP_SERVER.md:719 one-line sync is included. Its holder, task-0adea941 (REVIEW, completion landed 8ca8d389), edits only :2040 and :2991-3016, and worktree mode has no path holds.

Wrapper consumers read only `peersActive`: moe-agent.sh:4604 and :4780 (undeclared=='solo' and not peers_active), and moe-agent.ps1:4244. activePeerIds is informational.
finalizingAttemptsByTask (util/claimEligibility.ts:185) keeps only well-formed 'finalizing' records, the highest generation per task.
tsc in the daemon excludes *.test.ts, and vitest does not type-check. A tsc error probe confirmed that tsc does check source.
Architect dry run at 8ca8d389: RED 3 failed | 67 passed (70), GREEN 70/70, tsc clean. M-any-holder kills only (o2), and M-cross-task kills only (o3). Both checkRefs passed verbatim in a scratch clone, uncommitted and after a simulated landing commit. GREEN on the unfixed tree exits 1.
This repo runs worktree mode, so its own landings never hit the bug. Shared-mode projects hit it on every completion.
